subject: Taxes
title: Tax as User Experience
description: A fast breakdown of Tax as User Experience for builders.

hook.text: South Korea redesigned its tax portal using UX principles.

buildup.text: Poor UX causes errors, abandonment, and frustration.

discovery.text: Digital service designers found that tax portals violated basic UX rules: unclear labels, hidden buttons.

twist.text: Private tax software (TurboTax, H&R Block) invests millions in UX. Governments spend almost nothing.

climax.text: Tax compliance is a design problem as much as a legal one. Better interfaces would save billions in lost revenue.

punchline.text: Better buttons, 29% more completions. Tax compliance is UX design.

quiz.question: What happened when South Korea redesigned its tax portal?
